verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה׀ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיִּֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ אַרְצָ֔ם בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרְחָ֣ה הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ מִנַּ֤חַל אַרְנוֹן֙ עַד־ הַ֣ר חֶרְמ֔וֹן וְכָל־ הָעֲרָבָ֖ה מִזְרָֽחָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh mal·ḵê hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer hik·kū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl way·yir·šū ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣām bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên miz·rə·ḥāh haš·šā·meš min·na·ḥal ’ar·nō·wn ‘aḏ- har ḥer·mō·wn wə·ḵāl hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh miz·rā·ḥāh
verses.literal: Now these are the kings of the land whom the Israelites . . . struck down and whose lands they took beyond the Jordan to the east . . . from the Arnon Valley to Mount Hermon including all the Arabah eastward
verses.literalPt: Estes são os reis da terra aos quais os filhos de Israel feriram, cujas terras possuíram além do Jordão, para o nascente, desde o vale da torrente de Arnom até o monte Hermom, e toda a Arabá, ao oriente:

verses.original: סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י הַיּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן מֹשֵׁ֡ל מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־ שְׂפַת־ נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְת֤וֹךְ הַנַּ֙חַל֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הַגִּלְעָ֔ד וְעַד֙ יַבֹּ֣ק הַנַּ֔חַל גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî hay·yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ḥeš·bō·wn mō·šêl mê·‘ă·rō·w·‘êr ’ă·šer ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ- na·ḥal ’ar·nō·wn wə·ṯō·wḵ han·na·ḥal wa·ḥă·ṣî hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·‘aḏ yab·bōq han·na·ḥal gə·ḇūl bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: Sihon king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley along the middle of the valley up to the Jabbok River the border of the Ammonites that is, half of Gilead
verses.literalPt: a Seom, rei dos amorreus, que morava em Hesbom, e dominava desde Aroer, que está à beira do vale da torrente de Arnom, e desde o meio do vale, e a metade de Gileade, até o rio Jaboque, termo dos filhos de Amom;

verses.original: וְהָעֲרָבָה֩ עַד־ יָ֨ם כִּנְר֜וֹת מִזְרָ֗חָה וְ֠עַד יָ֣ם הָעֲרָבָ֤ה יָם־ הַמֶּ֙לַח֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה דֶּ֖רֶךְ בֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁמ֑וֹת וּמִ֨תֵּימָ֔ן תַּ֖חַת אַשְׁדּ֥וֹת הַפִּסְגָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh ‘aḏ- yām kin·rō·wṯ miz·rā·ḥāh wə·‘aḏ yām hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh yām- ham·me·laḥ miz·rā·ḥāh de·reḵ bêṯ hay·ši·mō·wṯ ū·mit·tê·mān ta·ḥaṯ ’aš·dō·wṯ hap·pis·gāh
verses.literal: as well as the Arabah east . . . of the Sea of Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea . . . eastward through Beth-jeshimoth and southward below the slopes of Pisgah
verses.literalPt: desde a Arabá até o mar de Quinerete, para o nascente, e até o mar da Arabá, o mar Salgado, para o nascente, pelo caminho de Bete-Jesimote; ao sul, debaixo das faldas de Pisga;

verses.original: וּגְב֗וּל ע֚וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן מִיֶּ֖תֶר הָרְפָאִ֑ים הַיּוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּעַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶֽעִי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḡə·ḇūl ‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ hab·bā·šān mî·ye·ṯer hā·rə·p̄ā·’îm hay·yō·wō·šêḇ bə·‘aš·tā·rō·wṯ ū·ḇə·’eḏ·re·‘î
verses.literal: And Og king of Bashan one of the remnant of the Rephaim who lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei
verses.literalPt: e o termo de Ogue, rei de Basã, que tinha ficado dos refains, o qual morava em Astarote e em Edrei

verses.original: וּ֠מֹשֵׁל בְּהַ֨ר חֶרְמ֤וֹן וּבְסַלְכָה֙ וּבְכָל־ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן עַד־ גְּב֥וּל הַגְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְהַמַּעֲכָתִ֑י וַחֲצִי֙ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד גְּב֖וּל סִיח֥וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ־ חֶשְׁבּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·šêl bə·har ḥer·mō·wn ū·ḇə·sal·ḵāh ū·ḇə·ḵāl hab·bā·šān ‘aḏ- gə·ḇūl hag·gə·šū·rî wə·ham·ma·‘ă·ḵā·ṯî wa·ḥă·ṣî hag·gil·‘āḏ gə·ḇūl sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ- ḥeš·bō·wn
verses.literal: He ruled over Mount Hermon Salecah all of Bashan up to the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon
verses.literalPt: e dominava no monte Hermom, e em Salcá, e em toda a Basã, até o termo dos gesuritas, e dos maacatitas, e da metade de Gileade, termo de Seom, rei de Hesbom.

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֧ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֛ה וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הִכּ֑וּם וַֽ֠יִּתְּנָהּ מֹשֶׁ֨ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֜ה יְרֻשָּׁ֗ה לָרֻֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְלַגָּדִ֔י וְלַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֥בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ- Yah·weh ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hik·kūm way·yit·tə·nāh mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ- Yah·weh yə·ruš·šāh lā·ru·’ū·ḇê·nî wə·lag·gā·ḏî wə·la·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ ham·naš·šeh
verses.literal: Moses the servant of the LORD and the Israelites . . . had struck them down and given their land as an inheritance to the Reubenites the Gadites and the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh
verses.literalPt: Moisés, servo de Jeová, e os filhos de Israel feriram-nos; e Moisés, servo de Jeová, deu as suas terras em possessão aos rubenitas, aos gaditas e à meia tribo de Manassés.

verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה מַלְכֵ֣י הָאָ֡רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ הִכָּ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יָ֔מָּה מִבַּ֤עַל גָּד֙ בְּבִקְעַ֣ת הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן וְעַד־ הָהָ֥ר הֶחָלָ֖ק הָעֹלֶ֣ה שֵׂעִ֑ירָה וַיִּתְּנָ֨הּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ לְשִׁבְטֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרֻשָּׁ֖ה כְּמַחְלְקֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh mal·ḵê hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer hik·kāh yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên yām·māh mib·ba·‘al gāḏ bə·ḇiq·‘aṯ hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn wə·‘aḏ- hā·hār he·ḥā·lāq hā·‘ō·leh śê·‘î·rāh way·yit·tə·nāh yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ lə·šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl yə·ruš·šāh kə·maḥ·lə·qō·ṯām
verses.literal: And these are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites . . . conquered beyond the Jordan to the west from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak which rises toward Seir according to the allotments to the tribes of Israel Joshua gave them as an inheritance
verses.literalPt: Estes são os reis da terra aos quais Josué e os filhos de Israel feriram além do Jordão; para o ocidente, desde Baal-Gade, no vale do Líbano, até o monte Halaque, que sobe a Seir; a qual terra Josué deu em possessão às tribos de Israel, segundo as suas divisões

verses.original: בָּהָ֣ר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֗ה וּבָֽעֲרָבָה֙ וּבָ֣אֲשֵׁד֔וֹת וּבַמִּדְבָּ֖ר וּבַנֶּ֑גֶב הַֽחִתִּי֙ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ הַפְּרִזִּ֔י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: bā·hār ū·ḇaš·šə·p̄ê·lāh ū·ḇā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh ū·ḇā·’ă·šê·ḏō·wṯ ū·ḇam·miḏ·bār ū·ḇan·ne·ḡeḇ ha·ḥit·tî hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî hap·pə·riz·zî ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: the hill country the foothills the Arabah the slopes the wilderness and the Negev the lands of the Hittites Amorites Canaanites Perizzites Hivites and Jebusites
verses.literalPt: ( Na região montanhosa, e na Sefelá, e na Arabá, e no Azedote, e no deserto, e no Neguebe habitavam os heteus, os amorreus, os cananeus, os ferezeus, os heveus e os jebuseus.):

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיח֖וֹ אֶחָ֑ד מֶ֧לֶךְ הָעַ֛י אֲשֶׁר־ מִצַּ֥ד בֵּֽית־ אֵ֖ל אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ yə·rî·ḥōw ’e·ḥāḏ me·leḵ hā·‘ay ’ă·šer- miṣ·ṣaḏ bêṯ- ’êl ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: the king of Jericho one the king of Ai which is near Bethel one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Jericó, um rei de Ai, que é perto de Betel,

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ חֶבְר֖וֹן אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Jerusalem one the king of Hebron one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Jerusalém, um rei de Hebrom,

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ יַרְמוּת֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ לָכִ֖ישׁ אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Jarmuth one the king of Lachish one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Jarmute, um rei de Laquis,

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ עֶגְלוֹן֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ גֶּ֖זֶר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Eglon one the king of Gezer one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Eglom, um rei de Gezer,

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ דְּבִר֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ גֶּ֖דֶר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Debir one the king of Geder one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Debir, um rei de Geder,

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ חָרְמָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עֲרָ֖ד אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Hormah one the king of Arad one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Hormá, um rei de Arade,

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ לִבְנָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עֲדֻלָּ֖ם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Libnah one the king of Adullam one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Libna, um rei de Adulão,

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ מַקֵּדָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֖ל אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Makkedah one the king of Bethel one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Maquedá, um rei de Betel,

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ תַּפּ֙וּחַ֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ חֵ֖פֶר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Tappuah one the king of Hepher one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Tapua, um rei de Hefer,

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ אֲפֵק֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ לַשָּׁר֖וֹן אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Aphek one the king of Lasharon one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Afeca, um rei de Lasarom,

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ מָדוֹן֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ חָצ֖וֹר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Madon one the king of Hazor one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Madom, um rei de Hazor,

verses.original: מֶ֣לֶךְ שִׁמְר֤וֹן מְראוֹן֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַכְשָׁ֖ף אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Shimron-meron one the king of Achshaph one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Sinrom-Merom, um rei de Acsafe,

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ תַּעְנַךְ֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ מְגִדּ֖וֹ אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Taanach one the king of Megiddo one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Taanaque, um rei de Megido,

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ קֶ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ יָקְנֳעָ֥ם לַכַּרְמֶ֖ל אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: the king of Kedesh one the king of Jokneam in Carmel one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Quedes, um rei de Jocneão, no Carmelo,

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ דּ֛וֹר לְנָפַ֥ת דּ֖וֹר אֶחָ֑ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ גּוֹיִ֥ם לְגִלְגָּ֖ל אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ dō·wr lə·nā·p̄aṯ dō·wr ’e·ḥāḏ me·leḵ- gō·w·yim lə·ḡil·gāl ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: the king of Dor in Naphath-dor one the king of Goiim in Gilgal one
verses.literalPt: um rei de Dor, no outeiro de Dor, um rei de Goim, em Gilgal,

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ תִּרְצָ֖ה אֶחָ֑ד כָּל־ מְלָכִ֖ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְאֶחָֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ tir·ṣāh ’e·ḥāḏ kāl- mə·lā·ḵîm šə·lō·šîm wə·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: and the king of Tirzah one So there were thirty-one kings in all
verses.literalPt: um rei de Tirza; por todos, trinta e um reis.
